subject: Partner Inventory
text: Partner items are automatically replenished upon returning to Arc Sophia.

evidence.quote: パートナーの所持アイテムは、アークソフィアに戻ると自動で補充される。
evidence.translation: Partner items are automatically replenished upon returning to Arc Sophia.

subject: Asuna
text: Because of the marriage bonus, Asuna's Teleport Crystals can be used without limit, but become temporarily unusable during the divorce event.

evidence.quote: 特にアスナに関しては、結婚ボーナスで相手のアイテムも使えるため、購入手段のない転移結晶が実質使い放題。...離婚イベントの進行中は一時的に使用不可になる。
evidence.translation: Especially regarding Asuna, because you can also use your partner's items with the marriage bonus, Teleport Crystals with no purchase method are practically unlimited use... During divorce event progression, it becomes temporarily unusable.

subject: Named Monsters
text: Some mid-bosses and NMs respawn after returning to town, after 10 to 12 hours elapse, or by defeating them, changing areas to auto-save, quitting to HOME, restarting, loading, and returning by changing area.

evidence.quote: 中ボスやNM（名前表示の赤い強敵）の中には、イベント終了後であっても討伐後に街に戻るか、...倒す→エリア切り替えしてオートセーブ→HOMEで終了→再起動→ロード→エリアチェンジで戻る、でも復活。...10〜12時間経過
evidence.translation: Some mid-bosses and NMs (red strong enemies) respawn after returning to town even after events... Defeat -> change area to auto-save -> quit with HOME -> restart -> load -> return by changing area, also respawns... 10 to 12 hours elapse

subject: Crimson Spinner
text: Crimson Spinner in Predator's Pilgrimage on Floor 76 awards 6,200 EXP, 150,000 Col, and drops Insect Thread x5.

evidence.quote: 76 | 捕食者の巡礼路 | クリムゾンスピナー | 6,200 | 150,000 | [素材]昆虫種の糸x5
evidence.translation: 76 | Predator's Pilgrimage | Crimson Spinner | 6,200 | 150,000 | [Material] Insect Thread x5

subject: Weapon Proficiency
text: Skill proficiency rises depending on monster level making aiming for 800 on lower floors take time, and auto-attacks provide more chances than Sword Skills.

evidence.quote: モンスターのレベルに応じてスキルの上がりやすさが決まっているため、低層で800を目指すのは非常に時間が掛かる。...ソードスキルを使うと短時間で倒してしまうので、オートアタックで何度も殴った方が上昇判定の回数も多くなる。
evidence.translation: Because skill ease of growth is determined according to monster level, aiming for 800 on lower floors takes a very long time... Because using Sword Skills defeats them in a short time, hitting many times with auto-attacks gives more skill rise check attempts.

subject: Weapon Proficiency
text: With any weapon, reaching 400 proficiency allows learning almost all battle skills.

evidence.quote: どの武器でも熟練度400もあればバトルスキルはほとんど覚えられるので、
evidence.translation: With any weapon, having 400 proficiency allows learning almost all battle skills

subject: Combat Training
text: In tutorial combat training, not switching leaves the bee HP around half for idle skill training up to around 500, provided the weapon lacks poison or bleed.

evidence.quote: チュートリアルの戦闘訓練を開始し、「スイッチを使え」の指示が出た状態でスイッチせずにいると...蜂のHPが半分ほどから減らなくなり、そのまま放置でスキル上げができる。...武器に毒・出血の効果がついていると状態異常のダメージで倒してしまう。...500くらいから急激に上がりづらくなる。
evidence.translation: If you start tutorial combat training and do not switch when instructed to use Switch... the bee HP stops decreasing from about half, allowing idle skill training... if the weapon has poison or bleed effects you will defeat it with status ailment damage... it becomes sharply harder to raise from around 500.

subject: Combat Training
text: Switching targets to strike the other 2 bees allows being attacked by 3 bees to train evasion or shield skill while strong regeneration is active.

evidence.quote: ターゲット切り替えで他の2匹も殴ってから放置すると、3匹にボコられ回避（あるいは盾）スキル上げにもなる。...訓練中は強リジェネが働いているが、不安なら吸収効果付きの武器やVIT・防御力の高くなる装備で。
evidence.translation: Switching targets and hitting the other 2 bees before idling lets Kirito get beaten by 3 bees to raise evasion or shield skill... Strong regeneration is active during training, but if uneasy equip HP absorb weapons or high VIT and defense gear.

subject: Spider Dojo
text: In Spider Dojo on Floor 76 Valley of the Defeated, 5 small spiders and 1 medium spider allow proficiency training up to 500 when ordering partners to fall back.

evidence.quote: 蜘蛛道場（熟練度:〜500）...場所は76層・敗者達の峡谷。洞窟を抜けてすぐの低地。小蜘蛛が5体、中型の蜘蛛が1体。...「後ろに下がれ」の指示で戦闘を放棄してくれるので活用しよう。
evidence.translation: Spider Dojo (proficiency: up to 500)... Location is Floor 76 Valley of the Defeated. Low ground immediately after exiting the cave. 5 small spiders and 1 medium spider... Order them to fall back so they abandon combat.

subject: Crimson Spinner
text: Changing area without defeating Crimson Spinner on Floor 76 restores its HP, or warping with Asuna's Teleport Crystal to Corridor of Battle Area immediately respawns it.

evidence.quote: 76層・捕食者の巡礼路のクリムゾンスピナー。...倒さずにエリアチェンジして戻るとHPが全快する。...追記：アスナとパーティ組んだ状態で、クリムゾンスピナー討伐後アスナの持っている転移結晶で戦域の回廊に飛べばすぐ復活している。
evidence.translation: Crimson Spinner in Predator's Pilgrimage on Floor 76... If you change area without defeating it and return, HP fully recovers... In a party with Asuna, after defeating Crimson Spinner, warping to Corridor of Battle Area with Asuna's Teleport Crystal immediately respawns it.

subject: Goblin Dojo
text: In Goblin Dojo on Floor 77 Pioneer Lands of Raging Warriors, 6 goblins allow continuous proficiency training up to 600 because the 1st respawns by the 6th defeat.

evidence.quote: ゴブリン道場（熟練度:〜600）...77層・荒ぶる戦鬼達の開拓地。...狭い範囲にゴブリンが6匹。...6匹目を倒し終わる頃には1匹目がリポップするため途切れなく狩り続けられる。
evidence.translation: Goblin Dojo (proficiency: up to 600)... Floor 77 Pioneer Lands of Raging Warriors... 6 goblins in a narrow area... By the time you finish defeating the 6th, the 1st respawns so you can hunt continuously.

subject: Lizardman Dojo
text: The third area of Floor 79 has about 14 lizardmen and 1 NM where Lizard Tongues sell for 3000 Col.

evidence.quote: 79層の3エリア目。見晴らしのいい広場に合計14匹くらい？...1匹NMがいるが、特に強くもないのでついでで食べてしまおう。...意外と金策にも有効でトカゲの舌は3000コルと高く売れる。
evidence.translation: Floor 79 third area. Total of about 14 in the open square?... There is 1 NM, but not particularly strong so take it down as well... Surprisingly effective for making money and Lizard Tongues sell high for 3000 Col.

subject: Fat Slime
text: On Floor 80 Labyrinth 2F, NM Fat Slime in 6 rooms is ideal for partner AI training while gathering 2 types of mucus and 3 types of ghost items.

evidence.quote: 80層迷宮区2階にてNMファットスライムとスパーリング。6部屋に1匹ずつ。...ここの強みはパートナーのAI育成を並行できること。攻撃力は大したことないがかなりタフなので的に最適。...倒す過程で2種の粘液と近くの亡霊たちから3種のアイテムを採れるのでそこそこ金策にもなる。
evidence.translation: Floor 80 Labyrinth 2F sparring with NM Fat Slime. 1 in each of 6 rooms... The strength here is partner AI training can be done simultaneously. Attack power is minor but very tough so ideal targets... In defeating them you get 2 types of mucus and 3 types of items from nearby ghosts.

subject: Blue Rogue Brothers
text: In Paradise of Man-Eating Flowers in Floor 88 first dungeon, 4 NM Blue Rogue Brothers are located close together in the westernmost passage.

evidence.quote: 88層最初のダンジョンの人食う花どもの楽園の最西の通路。...NMブルーローグブラザーズが4体も至近距離に配置されている。
evidence.translation: Floor 88 first dungeon Paradise of Man-Eating Flowers westernmost passage... 4 NM Blue Rogue Brothers are placed close together.

subject: Overeat
text: On Floor 92 Labyrinth 2F, SNM Overeat appears among normal dragons with strength comparable to a floor boss.

evidence.quote: 92層迷宮区2階に普通のドラゴンに交じってSNMオーバーイートがいる。...SNMといっても強さはフロアボスと同じくらいなので戦闘システムが把握できていれば余裕。
evidence.translation: On Floor 92 Labyrinth 2F, SNM Overeat is mixed in among normal dragons... Even as an SNM, strength is about equal to a floor boss so it is easy if you understand the combat system.

subject: High-Difficulty Quest NMs
text: High-difficulty quest NMs can be trapped in specific terrain, granting around 46000 to 50000 EXP until Kirito reaches level 170.

evidence.quote: 高難度...で出て来るNMはまともに戦うと非常に強いが、いずれも特定の地形に誘い込めばほぼ安全にハメ殺すことが可能。...また取得経験値もキリトのレベルが170前後になるまで安定して46000～50000程度入る
evidence.translation: NMs appearing in high-difficulty quests are very strong, but can be safely defeated by luring into specific terrain... Also acquired EXP is stable at around 46000 to 50000 until Kirito reaches around level 170.

subject: Cellurion
text: On Floor 94, defeat Hellion before pulling Cellurion to the bridge, and push Cellurion back periodically with Exact Onslaught.

evidence.quote: 94層:セルリオン...セルリオンを橋の所まで引っ張ってくる前に必ず橋の前のヘルリオンを倒しておくこと...セルリオンの顎の先端辺りまで近づいてエグザクトオンスロートで定期的に押し返す必要がある。
evidence.translation: Floor 94: Cellurion... Before pulling Cellurion to the bridge make sure to defeat Hellion in front of the bridge... approach near the tip of Cellurion's chin and push it back periodically with Exact Onslaught.

subject: Crimson Spinner
text: On Floor 96, lure Crimson Spinner between pillars, and counter Destiny Net using Exact Onslaught.

evidence.quote: 96層:クリムゾンスピナー...全く後が見えない状態で柱の間に誘導しなければならない...ディスティニーネットを撃たれたらエグザクトオンスロートで潰そう。
evidence.translation: Floor 96: Crimson Spinner... Must lure it between pillars without seeing behind... If Destiny Net is used crush it with Exact Onslaught.

subject: Inferno Dragon
text: On Floor 97, Sneaking and Invisible are essential when pulling Inferno Dragon into the passage to avoid extra enemies.

evidence.quote: 97層:インフェルノドラゴン...近所にアクティブの敵が多くいるので、余計な敵を引っかけない様にスニーキングとインビジブルは必須。...インフェルノドラゴンを通路に引き込む時は
evidence.translation: Floor 97: Inferno Dragon... Many active enemies nearby, so Sneaking and Invisible are essential to avoid extra enemies... When pulling Inferno Dragon into the passage

subject: Sachi's Message
text: Sachi's message can be used in Kirito's room.

evidence.quote: サチのメッセージはキリトの部屋で使える。
evidence.translation: Sachi's message can be used in Kirito's room.

subject: Mabethck
text: In Unearthed Grotto on Floor 84, NM Mabethck and antlion can be lured to entrance rocks where Mabethck gets caught for safe attacks.

evidence.quote: 84層：抉られた岩洞 NM：マーベスク...なのでタゲられたら入口付近まで戻ります。併せてアントライオンも一緒にトレインします。...すると入口付近の岩に引っ掛かってくれます。...通常攻撃だけでも安全に撃破可能。ソードスキル打ち放題。
evidence.translation: Floor 84: Unearthed Grotto NM: Mabethck... If targeted return near the entrance while training antlion together... It gets caught on the rock near the entrance... Safely defeatable with normal attacks alone and unlimited Sword Skills.

subject: Necro Dragon
text: In Dragon Ruins Center Room on Floor 88, retreating when targeted makes NM Necro Dragon get stuck so normal attacks can hit continuously.

evidence.quote: 88層：封竜遺跡 中央の間 NM：ネクロドラゴン...タゲられたら引き返します。...やっぱり引っ掛かります。...微妙に距離調整すると通常攻撃を当て続けられます
evidence.translation: Floor 88: Dragon Ruins Center Room NM: Necro Dragon... When targeted retreat... It gets stuck... With subtle distance adjustment you can continue hitting normal attacks

subject: Thrill of the Giant Spider
text: On Floor 96 Road of Wisdom, trapping NM Crimson Spinner near Corridor of Sturdy Lock gives 32000 to 38400 EXP at Lv129, and cancelling Thrill of the Giant Spider at NPC Kirby allows repeated fights.

evidence.quote: 96層：叡智に連なる街道 NM：クリムゾンスピナー...『堅剛なる錠の回廊』の入口付近にある大小の柱の間に引っ掛けます...そこから奥義連発！ 1～2回目32000exp 3～4回目38400exp（Lv129）...倒し終わったらNPCカービーの所へ行き『巨大グモの戦慄』クエストを『キャンセル』...もう一回クエスト受領すると何度でもクリムゾンスピナー退治出来ます。
evidence.translation: Floor 96: Road of Wisdom NM: Crimson Spinner... Trap it between large and small pillars near the entrance of Corridor of Sturdy Lock... Repeated secret skills from there! 1st-2nd time 32000exp 3rd-4th time 38400exp (Lv129)... After defeating, go to NPC Kirby and cancel the Thrill of the Giant Spider quest... Accepting the quest again lets you defeat Crimson Spinner repeatedly.

subject: Saw The Dragon's Figure
text: For quest Saw The Dragon's Figure on Floor 97 Coffin of Death King 1F, NM Inferno Dragon grants 38400 EXP around Lv.130 and can be repeated by cancelling at NPC Kirby.

evidence.quote: クエスト『竜の姿を見た！』 97層：極死王の霊柩1F NM：インフェルノドラゴン...討伐後、NPCカービーでクエストキャンセルすると何度でも受領可...Lv.130前後でほぼ毎回38400exp獲得出来た
evidence.translation: Quest Saw The Dragon's Figure! Floor 97: Coffin of Death King 1F NM: Inferno Dragon... After defeating, cancelling the quest at NPC Kirby allows accepting repeatedly... At around Lv.130 acquired 38400exp almost every time

subject: Date Conversation
text: In Arc Sophia date conversations, beginning conversation while seated on benches or fountains via X button increases the number of times you can speak.

evidence.quote: アークソフィアでのデート会話では、パートナーと座った状態で話はじめると話せる回数が増えます。...×ボタンで、ベンチや噴水、とりあえず座れるところなら座れます。
evidence.translation: In date conversations in Arc Sophia, beginning conversation while seated with your partner increases the number of times you can speak... With X button, you can sit on benches, fountains, or wherever you can sit.

subject: Hollow Strea
text: Against final boss Hollow Strea, unleash secret skills when HP is red and dash away, and heal in advance because small area attacks reach room corners in front of doors.

evidence.quote: ラスボスホロウストレアは、後半になると連続で広範囲技しかけてきます。でも敵のHPが赤くなってたら...奥義をぶっぱなったほうがいい。...んで奥義のちカーソル敵からはずしてもうダッシュで逃げるbこれを繰り返せば倒せる！...ちなみに時々小範囲技も使ってきますが...部屋の隅っこ(ドアの前)にいてもダメージくらうのであらかじめ回復を！！
evidence.translation: Final boss Hollow Strea continuously uses wide area attacks in the latter half. But if enemy HP is red... better to fire off secret skills... Then after secret skill remove cursor from enemy and dash away to repeat and defeat! By the way sometimes uses small area attacks... you take damage even at room corners in front of doors so heal in advance!!
